requirements.text: * 3-5 years of experience in backend software engineering, with experience building web services or applications.
* Experience with coding agents and automation tools.
* Familiarity with one of Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, with willingness to learn other languages.
* Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases (vector DBs), AI agents, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Familiarity with or willingness to learn Kubernetes and infrastructure as code.
* Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your role as well as use data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.

Join Guidewire as a Software Engineer II, Application Platform - AI Services, and be part of the team building our next-generation AI platform. This platform provides the essential tools to design AI agents, to connect to large language models, and manage the knowledge bases that power modern, intelligent insurance applications. You will be a contributor on this platform, using AI coding tools to build services that power developer experience, ensuring quality, scalability, and security. This is an onsite, full-time role based in the United States.
